user.title: Set up Gaian Grid Telemetry
user.description: In electric power distribution, the point of common coupling (PCC) is where a consumer's electrical circuit connects to the utility grid. If you have PCC sensors, choose those and you do not need anything else. If you do not have PCC sensors, even a single voltage, frequency, or device power sensor is still helpful.

data_description.grid_voltage_entity_ids: Choose one or more voltage sensors at the PCC in V. For many grid-tied inverters this is inverter voltage. For CTs or a meter at the main switchboard, use the PCC-side voltage.
data_description.additional_voltage_entity_ids: Use for other voltage sensors in V when you do not have PCC voltage, such as smart plugs or outlet monitors.
data_description.grid_frequency_entity_ids: Choose one or more frequency sensors at the PCC in Hz. For many grid-tied inverters this is inverter frequency. For CTs or a meter at the main switchboard, use the PCC-side frequency.
data_description.additional_frequency_entity_ids: Use for other frequency sensors in Hz when you do not have PCC frequency, such as smart plugs or outlet monitors.
data_description.grid_net_power_entity_ids: Use this if you have a single net PCC power sensor in W. This is often from CTs at the main switchboard. Do not also fill in PCC import power or PCC export power.
data_description.grid_net_power_sign_convention: Only used for PCC power (net). Choose whether your net PCC power sensor reports import as positive or negative.
data_description.grid_import_power_entity_ids: Use this if you have one or more separate PCC import sensors in W, often from a meter or CT setup at the main switchboard.
data_description.grid_export_power_entity_ids: Use this if you have one or more separate PCC export sensors in W, often from a meter or CT setup at the main switchboard.
data_description.additional_power_entity_ids: Use for other power sensors in W when you do not have PCC power, such as smart plugs, EV charging, or circuit loads.
data_description.telemetry_interval_seconds: Advanced. Used as the local publish interval until Gaian Grid sends managed settings.
data_description.heartbeat_interval_seconds: Advanced. Used as the local heartbeat interval until Gaian Grid sends managed settings.

reauth.title: Refresh Gaian Grid credentials
reauth.description: Enter a fresh enrollment token to rotate the broker credentials for this Gaian Grid site.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Gaian Grid telemetry
reconfigure.description: Update the local sensor selection and fallback intervals. If you have PCC sensors, choose those and you do not need anything else. If you do not have PCC sensors, even a single voltage, frequency, or device power sensor is still helpful.

error.sensor_selection_required: Select at least one supported electricity sensor.
error.duplicate_sensor_selection: Each sensor can only be selected once.
error.conflicting_grid_power_selection: Choose either PCC net power sensors or separate PCC import/export sensors, not both.

error.invalid_enrollment_token: The enrollment token is invalid, expired, revoked, or already used.
